The page's signal graph is clear now. Next I'll check how Angular implements `chain` and `debounced` in the installed version, plus the routes and server endpoints.   

Grep found no `chain` or `debounced` declarations, so I'll check the installed Angular version and the server's deal route and middleware.   

The server adds a random 200–2200 ms delay to every request, which explains the slowness. Next I need the exact semantics of `chain` and `debounced` in Angular 22. 

`chain` returns the other resource's value and propagates its status, so `selectedDealResource` re-runs on every `dealsResource` change. Next I'll check how the resource runtime decides when to re-run params. 

`extRequest` is a `linkedSignal` that wraps params in a new object on every recompute, so any recompute of params triggers a reload. Next I'll check `debounced`'s implementation and the child components that might write state back.  

`debounced()` is itself a resource driven by an internal `effect`, so it can't create a cycle on its own. Next I'll check the editor's effect (it reads `deal` and `tasks` in editor mode) and the app and deals routes.  

The interceptor retries at most 3 times, so it can't be an unbounded loop. The last remaining UI path that emits `dealId` changes is the `ngListbox` in the master list, so I'll check when `@angular/aria` emits `valueChange`.
</details></think>

    if (!query) return this.dealsState();

    return this.dealsState().filter((deal) =>
      [deal.title, this.accountName(deal.accountId), this.contactName(deal.contactId)].some(
        (value) => value.toLowerCase().includes(query),
      ),
    );

import { Router } from 'express';
import { store } from '../store.js';
import { authMiddleware } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import type { DealUpdateRequest } from '../types.js';

const router = Router();

router.use(authMiddleware);

/**
 * GET /deals
 * List all deals (without embedded tasks).
 */
router.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json(store.getDeals());
});

/**
 * GET /deals/:dealId
 * Get a single deal by ID (without embedded tasks).
 */
router.get('/:dealId', (req, res) => {
  const deal = store.getDeal(req.params.dealId);

  if (!deal) {
    res.status(404).json({
      error: { status: 404, message: 'Deal not found', code: 'NOT_FOUND' },
    });
    return;
  }

  res.json(deal);
});

/**
 * PUT /deals/:dealId
 * Update deal fields. Tasks are managed via the /tasks sub-resource.
 */
router.put('/:dealId', (req, res) => {
  const updated = store.updateDeal(req.params.dealId, req.body as DealUpdateRequest);

  if (!updated) {
    res.status(404).json({
      error: { status: 404, message: 'Deal not found', code: 'NOT_FOUND' },
    });
    return;
  }

  res.json(updated);
});

export default router;
```

export class DealEditor implements IHaveUnsavedChanges {
  readonly deal = input<Deal>();
  readonly tasks = input<readonly DealTask[]>([]);

  readonly saved = output<DealEditorValue>();
  readonly cancelled = output<void>();

  private readonly model = linkedSignal(() => toValue(this.deal(), this.tasks()));
  protected readonly dealForm = form(this.model, dealSchema);

  protected readonly stages = Object.keys(DEAL_STAGE_LABELS) as DealStage[];
  protected readonly stageLabels = DEAL_STAGE_LABELS;
  protected readonly priorities = Object.keys(TASK_PRIORITY_LABELS) as TaskPriority[];
  protected readonly priorityLabels = TASK_PRIORITY_LABELS;

  constructor() {
    // Tracks only the inputs, so user edits do not clear dirty state.
    effect(() => {
      this.deal();
      this.tasks();
      untracked(() => this.dealForm().reset());
    });
  }

  protected onSubmit(): void {
    void submit(this.dealForm, async () => {
      this.saved.emit(this.model());
    });
  }

  protected addTask(): void {
    this.model.update((value) => ({ ...value, tasks: [...value.tasks, emptyTask()] }));
    this.dealForm().markAsDirty();
  }

  protected removeTask(index: number): void {
    this.model.update((value) => ({
      ...value,
      tasks: value.tasks.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
    }));

import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';

export const API_URL = new InjectionToken('API_URL', {
  factory: () => 'http://localhost:3000/api/', // TODO: enviroment.ts
});

export const Auth = new InjectionToken('Auth', {
  factory: () => ({
    getToken: () => 'mock-access-u1',
  }),
});

export const URLInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  if (req.url.match(/^https?:/)) return next(req);

  const url = inject(API_URL); // Lazy

  return next(
    req.clone({
      url: url + req.url,
    }),
  );
};

  if (req.headers.has('Authorization')) return next(req);

      setHeaders: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${auth.getToken()}`,

  );

## Why a dealId change fans out into repeated requests

1. **The URL effect echoes a stale filter.** When  changes, the effect navigates with . If the user typed within the last 300 ms, that stale value is written back to the URL and overwrites . That changes the debounced value again, which reloads .
2. ** couples the detail request to the list.** In the Angular resource runtime,  throws a loading status while the list reloads, then returns the list value. The params  wraps the result in a new object each time, so every list reload also re-fetches `GET /api/deals/:id`.
3. **Each request is slow.** The server adds a random 200-2200 ms delay to every call (`server/src/index.ts#L25-L28`). The error interceptor retries 500s up to 3 times with backoff and a 5 s timeout (`src/app/core/http/index-interceptor.ts#L71-L88`).

I traced each cycle and it terminates: the URL echo is idempotent once the values match. So from the code alone I can confirm a fan-out of list and detail requests per filter or selection change, but not an unbounded loop. Confirming the exact repeating request needs a runtime trace.

- Drop  from ; its params should be `() => this.selectedDealId()`.
- Write the URL from  (not the debounced value), or merge both into one effect with a single source of truth.

import { Component, DestroyRef, inject, model, output } from '@angular/core';
import { SharedModule } from '@shared';

const FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-deals-filter',
  imports: [SharedModule],
  template: `
    <mat-form-field class="w-full">
      <mat-label>Filter deals</mat-label>
      <input
        matInput
        type="search"
        #filterInput
        [value]="value()"
        (input)="onInput(filterInput.value)"
      />
      <mat-icon matSuffix aria-hidden="true">search</mat-icon>
    </mat-form-field>
  `,
  host: { class: 'block' },
})
export class DealsFilter {
  readonly value = model('');
  readonly debouncedChange = output<string>();

  private timerId?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

  constructor() {
    inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(() => clearTimeout(this.timerId));
  }

  protected onInput(text: string): void {
    this.value.set(text);
    clearTimeout(this.timerId);
    this.timerId = setTimeout(() => this.debouncedChange.emit(text), FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }
}
```

```
import { Component, effect, model, output, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { SharedModule } from '@shared';

const FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-deals-filter',
  imports: [SharedModule],
  template: `
    <mat-form-field class="w-full">
      <mat-label>Filter deals</mat-label>
      <input
        matInput
        type="search"
        #filterInput
        [value]="value()"
        (input)="onInput(filterInput.value)"
      />
      <mat-icon matSuffix aria-hidden="true">search</mat-icon>
    </mat-form-field>
  `,
  host: { class: 'block' },
})
export class DealsFilter {
  readonly value = model('');
  readonly debouncedChange = output<string>();

  // null skips the initial run so the URL value is not overwritten
  private readonly pendingText = signal<string | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    effect((onCleanup) => {
      const text = this.pendingText();
      if (text === null) return;

      const timerId = setTimeout(() => this.debouncedChange.emit(text), FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS);
      onCleanup(() => clearTimeout(timerId));
    });
  }

  protected onInput(text: string): void {
    this.value.set(text);
    this.pendingText.set(text);
  }
}
```
